Menus

A menu is a short list of actions or choices that opens from a button: the browser's popover, placed beside the button by CSS anchor positioning, driven by the keyboard as the WAI-ARIA menu button.

Examples

The button opens the menu with the browser's command - commandfor names the menu, command="toggle-popover" opens and closes it - and the library keeps its aria-expanded, which Firefox does not give such a button. No script is needed to open a menu; the library adds the arrow keys.

Open on the site 
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="menu-actions-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i>Actions</button>
<div id="menu-actions-list" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Actions">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i>Edit</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-files" aria-hidden="true"></i>Duplicate</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true"><i class="bi bi-archive" aria-hidden="true"></i>Archive</button>
	<a class="menu-item" href="#menu-actions" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>Open on the site</a>
	<hr class="menu-divider">
	<button class="menu-item menu-item-danger" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Delete</button>
</div>

Choices and headers

A choice of one is a set of menuitemradio items, the chosen one aria-checked="true" with a check drawn after it. menu-header titles a part of the menu. menu-start lines the menu up with its button's start edge instead of its end.

Work context
<button class="btn btn-text" type="button" commandfor="menu-choice-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><span class="dot dot-success"></span>All sites<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<div id="menu-choice-list" class="menu menu-start" popover role="menu" aria-label="Work context">
	<div class="menu-header">Work context</div>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true"><i class="bi bi-grid-3x3-gap" aria-hidden="true"></i>All sites</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>lagoon.example</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>northbay.example</button>
</div>

Items that stay checked

A menuitemcheckbox chosen flips its aria-checked, and a menuitemradio in a role="group" checks itself and unchecks the others of its group; the menu stays open for the next choice, and the page hears redz:check with detail.item and detail.checked. A menuitemradio outside a group is a choice of one, as above: it checks itself and closes the menu.

Sort by
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="menu-checks-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><i class="bi bi-layout-three-columns" aria-hidden="true"></i>Columns<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<div id="menu-checks-list" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Columns">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="true">Guest</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="true">Tour</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="false">Pickup</button>
	<div class="menu-header" id="menu-checks-sort">Sort by</div>
	<div role="group" aria-labelledby="menu-checks-sort">
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true">Date</button>
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">Name</button>
	</div>
</div>

The items of an open menu. :focus-visible is where the arrow keys are; aria-current="true" marks the page a menu of links is on.

Keyboard and accessibility

KeyOn the buttonIn the menu
Enter, SpaceOpens the menu, the focus on the checked or the first itemRuns the item and closes the menu
↓ / ↑Opens the menu on the first / the last itemThe next / the previous item, round the ends
Home / End-The first / the last item
A letter-The next item that begins with it
Esc-Closes the menu, the focus back on the button
Tab-Closes the menu and moves on
  • The menu is popover with role="menu" and a name; its items are menuitem, menuitemradio or menuitemcheckbox. A list of site sections is navigation, not a menu - use links.
  • The button carries aria-haspopup="menu"; the library keeps its aria-expanded, and the browser moves the focus back to it on close and closes the menu on a click outside or Esc.
  • Where an engine does not put the menu beside its button - no anchor positioning below Firefox 147 and Safari 26, no anchor from a popover's button in Chrome 130-132, a table cell in Chrome 135-136, the bottom of a long page in Safari 26 - js/menu-place.js places it, again when the page scrolls or the menu or its button changes size, and the probes record each such place.

Tokens

From css/components/menu.css, which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's --redz-space-4, --redz-border, --redz-radius-12, --redz-bg-raised, --redz-shadow-2, --redz-text, --redz-space-8, --redz-text-muted, --redz-fs-12, --redz-control-height, --redz-radius-8, --redz-bg-hover, --redz-text-faint, --redz-primary, --redz-danger, --redz-motion, --redz-ease.
